_comment: Corrections to the walls extracted from the Museum Industriekultur plans, in the site frame (metres, x along the image, y up).
Connector areas are read off the plans and checked against the landmarks where the training walks change floor.
Floor -1 exists only as the landing of the east stairwell; its plan has no walls, so the landing outline is added as walls and as the level's footprint.
The west stairwell and the lift run between floors 0 and -2 without stopping at -1, so they list only those two.
